concepts.name: The Scribe
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: first-round logo concept for Inkborne, a web app bringing playable tabletop character sheets and character stories together.
Brand personality: a useful, personal player's field journal. Warm editorial craft, confident and practical, with a subtle imaginative character. Identity should work beyond one fantasy game system.
Composition: one large standalone symbol centered above the wordmark "Inkborne" on a clean, uniform warm ivory background (#F4F0E6). The symbol and wordmark must be solid dark ink (#282A25), with generous clear space and balanced optical spacing. Use a refined readable Garamond-like book serif for the wordmark. Render the exact name once, spelled I n k b o r n e.
Style: deliberate professional identity design, flat vector-like shapes, strong silhouette, controlled negative space. The symbol should remain recognizable as a tiny app icon.
Constraints: one concept only, no slogans or explanatory labels, no sheet of alternatives, no gradients, shadows, metallic effects, texture, ornamental flourishes, dragons, dice, shields, crests, paper mockups, scenery, 3D or watermarks. This is an idea exploration image, not a production vector file.
Concept A — The Scribe: create a bold upright fountain-pen nib silhouette whose broad central negative space subtly forms a capital I. The nib should read immediately as an ink instrument. Use compact balanced shoulders and a simple, deliberate outline. Avoid a tiny decorative nib hole and avoid nested icon puzzles. The mark must feel intentional and quietly distinctive.
